verdict.rationale: LocalAI is self-hosted and local-first, meaning models, configs, and chat data reside on the user's own machine rather than a vendor cloud, and it uses standard OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API formats rather than proprietary ones — this architecture inherently avoids lock-in. However, there is no explicit documentation of a data-export feature, export tooling, or open-format guarantee for chat history/agent state. missing for 10: an explicit export/backup feature, documentation on chat/session data formats, and any independent confirmation that user data can be fully extracted and ported elsewhere.
